ps.brief: Puzzle 1, Monarch: Give check to the enemy King. White to move.
ps.lesson: Checks first: always scan for a check before anything else.

ps.brief: Puzzle 2, Monarch: Give check to the enemy King. White to move.
ps.lesson: On an open board the Monarch reaches checking squares from far away.

ps.brief: Puzzle 3, Monarch: Give check to the enemy King. White to move.
ps.lesson: Count the lines into the King; the Monarch needs only one.

ps.brief: Puzzle 4, Monarch: Give check to the enemy King. White to move.
ps.lesson: A check also takes away the opponent's choices.

ps.brief: Puzzle 5, Monarch: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: Safe captures only: make sure nothing can take back.

ps.brief: Puzzle 6, Monarch: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: In a crowded position, check who defends the piece before grabbing it.

ps.brief: Puzzle 7, Monarch: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: A capture that loses your Monarch is not a win. Count attackers and defenders.

ps.brief: Puzzle 8, Monarch: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: Look for the undefended piece; that's free material.

ps.brief: Puzzle 9, Monarch: Give check to the enemy King. White to move.
ps.lesson: No special trait here: the Monarch's own movement pattern is the weapon.

ps.brief: Puzzle 10, Monarch: Give check to the enemy King. White to move.
ps.lesson: Know exactly which squares the Monarch controls.

ps.brief: Puzzle 11, Monarch: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: The Monarch wins by geometry: find the line the defence forgot.

ps.brief: Puzzle 12, Monarch: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: Master the basic pattern before the fancy ones.

ps.brief: Puzzle 13, Monarch: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: Fork: one move, two targets. The Monarch hits the King and a valuable piece at once.

ps.brief: Puzzle 14, Monarch: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: When the King is in check it must escape, so the second target falls.

ps.brief: Puzzle 15, Monarch: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: Double attacks win material even against careful defence.

ps.brief: Puzzle 16, Monarch: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: Look for a square that attacks two things at once.

ps.brief: Puzzle 17, Monarch: Capture the enemy King in 2 moves. White to move.
ps.lesson: Take the King in two: first remove every escape square, then strike.

ps.brief: Puzzle 18, Monarch: Capture the enemy King in 2 moves. White to move.
ps.lesson: Pieces in front of their own King often become a trap.

ps.brief: Puzzle 19, Monarch: Capture the enemy King in 3 moves. White to move.
ps.lesson: Three moves deep: plan backwards from the final capture.

ps.brief: Puzzle 20, Monarch: Capture the enemy King in 3 moves. White to move.
ps.lesson: Even active defenders can't help if every move is forcing.
